rules.note: The review file (scripts/shop-photo-review-pilot.md) numbers its rules only loosely ("A1–A7", "A8–A10", "rules for the remaining comode"). This is the full list as applied in every v3 prompt, numbered so a review can cite them.

A.A1: Keep the exact height-to-width ratio of the render and state it in words; never slimmer, longer or taller than the render.
A.A2: Anchor the scale with three references in the frame (2.05 m door or frame, 2.60 m ceiling, socket at 30 cm; in a bathroom the 85 cm washing machine or basin rim replaces the socket).
A.A3: TV size as a fraction of the furniture length, 16:9.
A.A4: Each photo is a different apartment: wall colour, floor, window side and decor vary; no ribbed vase, no olive branch, no soundbar-plus-curtain-left set.
A.A5: No lettering anywhere: plain book spines, no labels on jars or bottles, no markings on appliances.
A.A6: Props usable where they are: hooks at 1.70 m on a free wall, appliances centred under worktops, nothing hung above a mirror.
A.A7: Wall-hung pieces: mounting height twice, as a number and as a relation to what is below and to the ceiling.
A.A8: No ceiling lamp in the frame.
A.A9: 35 mm lens from far enough back; the far end of the piece at least 80% as high in the picture as the near end; no wide-angle stretching.
A.A10: Exactly one personal object, picked per photo so it never repeats within a product; no slippers; coats, bags and umbrellas only in a hall; no fruit bowl in a bedroom or hall.
A.A11: The fronts cover the entire front of the piece: no frame, header, stile or rail around or between doors and drawers.
A.A12: Floor-standing pieces: a 10 cm plinth set back 3 cm, visible along the whole bottom; never a flush block or legs.
A.A13: Access and placement: clear floor in front (85 cm for cupboards), nothing within 90 cm of the fronts, window and radiator on another wall or at least 1 m away, tall cupboards tight to a side wall with a 15–20 cm strip of wall below the ceiling; a piece as wide as its wall touches both side walls.
A.A14: No lighting inside or under the furniture: no LED strips, no glowing lines; table and desk lamps switched off.

mirror.M1: A mirror reflects only this room, in correct perspective, with straight wall and ceiling lines.
mirror.M2: Every object in the reflection also exists in the room; nothing appears only in the mirror.
mirror.M3: No camera, photographer or person in the reflection; no doorway to a second room; no framed photographs of people.
mirror.M4: Mirror doors: white body, the mirror covers the whole door with a 1 cm edge. (No v3 photo has mirror doors; M1–M3 apply to the wall mirrors of the bathroom and hall scenes.)

C.C1: The chest is the only cabinet furniture in the photo: no wardrobe, no second chest, no shelving unit; no TV on a bedroom chest.
C.C2: The top of the chest relates to the room-door handle at 1.05 m (below it for chests up to 95 cm; the 120 cm tallboy 15 cm above it).
C.C3: GOLA: one straight metal channel above each drawer front, full width, same thickness on every drawer; nothing else on the fronts.
C.C4: Knobs: one small round 3 cm knob centred on each drawer front, all identical.
C.C5: Body, plinth and fronts in exactly the light colours named; no black or dark grey panels anywhere on a chest or wall unit.
